name: What is the process for hiring City Dweller, LLC for drywall repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for hiring City Dweller, LLC for drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for hiring City Dweller, LLC typically begins with a consultation where we assess the drywall damage in your home. We then provide a detailed, written estimate outlining the scope of work, materials, and cost. Upon approval, we schedule the repair at your convenience. Our team carefully prepares the area, executes the repairs, ensures proper drying and finishing, and cleans up thoroughly. We aim to complete the project efficiently with minimal disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an assessment, detailed estimate, scheduling, professional repair by our team, and thorough cleanup upon completion.
